statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id // "Unknown"'); used_ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); rate_limit=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); weekly_limit=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.weekly.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$used_ctx" ]; then v=$(printf '%.0f' "$used_ctx"); if [ "$v" -ge 90 ]; then ctx_str="\u001b[1;31m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; elif [ "$v" -ge 70 ]; then ctx_str="\u001b[33m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; else ctx_str="${v}% used"; fi; else ctx_str="0% used"; fi; if [ -n "$rate_limit" ]; then v=$(printf '%.0f' "$rate_limit"); if [ "$v" -ge 90 ]; then lim_str="\u001b[1;31m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; elif [ "$v" -ge 70 ]; then lim_str="\u001b[33m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; else lim_str="${v}% used"; fi; else lim_str="0% used"; fi; if [ -n "$weekly_limit" ]; then v=$(printf '%.0f' "$weekly_limit"); if [ "$v" -ge 90 ]; then wk_str="\u001b[1;31m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; elif [ "$v" -ge 70 ]; then wk_str="\u001b[33m${v}% used\u001b[0m"; else wk_str="${v}% used"; fi; else wk_str="0% used"; fi; printf "model\t\t\t\tcontext\t\tsession limit\tweekly limit\n%s\t\t%s\t\t%s\t\t%s\n" "$model" "$ctx_str" "$lim_str" "$wk_str"
